summary_responses.subtopic: Privacy Act & Law Enforcement Systems of Records
summary_responses.response:
The Department of Justice’s Office of Justice Programs has proposed a new system of records, JUSTICE/OJP-017, to support the Bureau of Justice Statistics’ work collecting and analyzing justice-related data.  
The system would include information from surveys, interviews, focus groups, and administrative records involving crime, victims, offenders, courts, corrections, civil proceedings, and related government operations.  
Records may contain sensitive personal, criminal-history, demographic, medical, financial, employment, and identifying information gathered from individuals and justice agencies.
